fields.label: Will you be attending?
fields.helpText: Please let us know so we can plan accordingly.

fields.label: Your Full Name
fields.helpText: Enter the name(s) as you'd like them on the seating chart.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.helpText: We'll send event details and updates to this address.

fields.label: Number of Guests in Your Party
fields.helpText: Include yourself. Enter 1 if you're coming solo.

fields.label: Dietary Restrictions
fields.helpText: Select all that apply. We want everyone to enjoy the meal.

fields.label: Additional Notes
fields.helpText: Anything else we should know? Special requests, accessibility needs, etc.

thank_you.title: You're on the list!
thank_you.body_md: Thank you for responding — your RSVP has been received. We can't wait to celebrate with you. Check your email for a confirmation and keep an eye out for further details closer to the date.
